//: Page budgets (docs/MOBILE.md): ceilings per page@setup-text. A ratchet: started at the measured values plus 2% (20 Nov 2026); a stage lowers the pages it changes to its acceptance figures, never raises one. The one exception: a control a later stage added on purpose, measured in its release with the same plus 2%, its reason on the entry (why). small = touch targets under 44px on the first screen.

intel@i15-100.why: Release 6 (S7a, 20 Nov 2026): Matchup Intel's lane selector (Top, Jungle, Mid, ADC, Support), a 46px row the page did not have when the ceilings were set; measured 1.12 at i15 and 3.60 at se1 150%. S7a's unbuilt phone 'Remember' icon toggle would give a row back.

resources@i15-100.why: S8a (20 Nov 2026): each site's host on a line of its own (UD.R1: beside the title it was cut), a line more on every row; measured 1.81 at i15 and 5.94 at se1 150%.

settings@i15-100.why: Release 6 (S9b): 'Sign out of other devices', 109px; S8a (20 Nov 2026): 'On this device' (DIRECTIVE §7.2c), what this browser remembers with Clear, about 400px (more at large text, where its lines and button wrap); measured 2.27 at i15 and 7.52 at se1 150%.

a-branding@i15-100.why: S9c (20 Nov 2026): Branding's phone section index (one line of links) and the Public team page section, where /admin/public-access now lands inside Admin Mode; measured 4.12 at i15 and 12.71 at se1 150%.
